Registration via Google OAuth or email+password
preparation: Google account or email for registration
Tool name, URL, category, description, pricing model

workflow: Open https://aitoolsmagazine.com/ and click 'Submit Your AI Tool' (goes to /submit-listing/details/)
Sign in with Google or register with email
Complete the listing details form after auth

Site has an 'AI Tool Badge Generator' — likely badge/link exchange mechanics
Affiliate Disclosure present — some listings may be affiliate-linked
countsAsLive: The tool has a aitoolsmagazine.com/listing/<slug>/ page linked from its listing-category page
